svg.title: The ka-tet: five seats of an orchestral agentic AI system
svg.desc: Five seats, their disciplines, cylinder sizes and publish rights, plus the key-separation arithmetic of the mesh that connects them. Measured 2026-09-03. The same figures appear as a table in the page text.
